ps2.4:1.2: “mettāya bhikkhave cetovimuttiyā āsevitāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricittāya susamāraddhāya ekādasānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
